name: Ashtanga Yoga Shala Rosario
reason: Too thin: its own site (ashtangarosario.com; robots.txt allows us; the list's .com.ar address redirects there) offers one thing, the shala's Mysore and led classes (in person and online) with a monthly pass price list (Abono Ilimitado $58.000 and others); there are no workshops, retreats, trainings (the site says it gives none) or free resources, and no dated news to show current activity beyond the timetable. Founded October 2010 by María Di Masso (Level 2 authorised); email info@ashtangarosario.com; images on esmsv.com load for the ingest.
